description: This file implements HTTP authentication mechanisms for the CCSP CWMP protocol, including functions for calculating digest responses, generating challenges and responses, parsing authentication headers, and handling HTTP headers related to authentication. It is part of a Connection Request Handler Object responsible for managing authentication steps in HTTP transactions.

methods.description: Skips leading whitespace characters (' ' and '\t') in a message buffer.

methods.description: Skips trailing whitespace characters from the end of a buffer.

methods.description: Calculates the digest response used in HTTP digest authentication.

methods.description: Calculates the HA1 portion of the digest as specified in RFC 2617.

methods.description: Calculates the HA2 digest for HTTP digest authentication.

methods.description: Extracts authentication information from an HTTP request.

methods.description: Parses the digest authentication header to extract its parameters.

methods.description: Generates a basic authentication challenge string.

methods.description: Generates a digest authentication challenge string with parameters.

methods.description: Generates a HTTP response with WWW-Authenticate header for Digest auth.

methods.description: Constructs the entire HTTP response message including headers and body.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpTcpcrhoGenNonce(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pNonce,ULONG ulNonceLen)
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure nonce value.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpTcpcrhoVerify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hAuthInfo,PUCHAR pPassword,ULONG ulServerAuthType,PUCHAR pServerAuthRealm,PUCHAR pServerNonce,ULONG ulNonceTimeout,ULONG ulNonceTimestamp)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials against the request and expected authentication types.

methods.name: CcspCwmpTcpcrhoVerify
methods.description: Verifies the user's credentials by parsing the HTTP request, validating authentication headers, computing expected response digests, and checking nonce validity. Supports Basic and Digest authentication types, ensuring proper matching of credentials and nonces.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpTcpcrhoGenResResponse(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,PULONG pulSize,char * pMediaType,char * pRes,ULONG ulResLen)
methods.description: Generates an HTTP response message for resource retrieval, including headers such as Content-Type, Content-Length, and timestamp, and appends the resource content if provided.
